coverage.rationale: The review agent recommended adding 'Access = Internal;' to the new page object to narrow its exported surface, but Access is not a supported property on page objects in AL and the compiler rejects it with error AL0124 (documented supported object types for Access do not include Page). The developer reply confirms this makes the suggestion inapplicable, so the entry's expected_comments is empty and this guards against re-flagging the same unsupported-property suggestion on a page's Access property without encoding it as either an expected or ignored comment.
